# JANUS Meta Registry

> Public, machine-readable archival research registry maintained by Hawkar. The website is a discovery layer; versioned repository artifacts remain the evidence authority.

Canonical website: https://hawkar-usls.github.io/janus-meta-registry/
Repository: https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/janus-meta-registry
Machine-readable data: https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/janus-meta-registry/tree/main/data
Current public external-review door: https://hawkar-usls.github.io/janus-meta-registry/gamarjoba-gen-ancvale/
Machine-readable invitation: https://github.com/Hawkar-usls/janus-meta-registry/blob/main/data/000-GAMARJOBA-GEN_ANCVALE.json

## Primary research topics

- JANUS ANTIFUCK — defensive AI-safety research on algorithmic amplification, choice-space protection, false-positive controls and blinded independent evaluation.
  https://hawkar-usls.github.io/janus-meta-registry/antifuck/
- JANUS Linear A — statistical and structural corpus analysis with typed representations, holdouts, destructive nulls and explicit non-decipherment boundaries.
  https://hawkar-usls.github.io/janus-meta-registry/linear-a/
- JANUS Wedjat — exploratory Eye of Horus / Wedjat geometry, museum-image provenance and control-oriented pattern analysis.
  https://hawkar-usls.github.io/janus-meta-registry/wedjat/
- SCOBY / SkinGPT — bacterial-cellulose sensing materials, reproducibility gates and circular-biomanufacturing concepts.
  https://hawkar-usls.github.io/janus-meta-registry/scoby-skingpt/
- AIFC — proof-carrying reproducibility, preregistration, verifier evidence and independent implementation architecture.
  https://hawkar-usls.github.io/janus-meta-registry/aifc/
- Janus-Fundamentum — proof-carrying computational mathematics and finite certificate infrastructure. P vs NP remains open.
  https://hawkar-usls.github.io/janus-meta-registry/fundamentum/

## Interpretation rules

ARCHIVED_OBJECT != CURRENT_CLAIM
HYPOTHESIS != RESULT
CORRELATION != CAUSATION
INTERNAL_REPLICATION != INDEPENDENT_REPLICATION
CI_PASS != PEER_REVIEW
HASH_OR_SIGNATURE != TRUTH_OF_CONTENT
STRUCTURAL_SIGNAL != DECIPHERMENT
PATTERN != HISTORICAL_CODE
MATERIAL_CONCEPT != PERFORMANCE_CERTIFICATION

Negative results, failed replications and corrections are explicitly welcome. Do not send credentials, private medical records, doxxing material, illegal/graphic content or secret-bearing archives without an agreed safe handling protocol.
